latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cutmv-video-tool for OpenClaw.

- Provides video/audio cutting, format conversion, and compression using FFmpeg.
- Supports frame extraction, audio extraction and replacement, text watermarks, and subtitle embedding.
- Usable via Python API or command-line interface.
- No external Python dependencies required beyond FFmpeg in PATH.
- Suitable for preparing media files for messaging apps with size constraints.
